Tidal Traveler.sa2: While benefitting from IMMUNITY, BUBBLE attacks deal 25/35/50% bonus damage. Also DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).

Time Thief.name: Time Thief
Time Thief.sa1: When landing a HIT while throwing her head, Ms. Fortune gains HASTE for 10 seconds and deals damage equal to 50/75/100% of her ATTACK.
Time Thief.sa2: 50/75/100% of the damage suffered while in HEADLESS MODE is regained when Ms. Fortune recalls her head.

Timeless Hero.name: Timeless Hero
Timeless Hero.sa1: Gain ENRAGE, AUTO-BLOCK or REGEN every 30/25/20 COMBO HITS. These BUFFs are removed when suffering a HIT.
Timeless Hero.sa2: Once per match when obtaining all of the above BUFFS, gain 50/75/100% BLOCKBUSTER METER and infinite STAR POWER.

Toad Warrior.name: Toad Warrior
Toad Warrior.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while near an opponent.
Toad Warrior.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage while a BLOCKBUSTER is fully charged.

Tomb & Gloom.name: Tomb & Gloom
Tomb & Gloom.sa1: Inflict WITHER, CURSE, QUIETUS or HEX for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE.
Tomb & Gloom.sa2: Also gain 1 stack of EVASION for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

Treble Maker.name: Treble Maker
Treble Maker.sa1: Heal for 5/7/10% of your MAX HEALTH after every 10th COMBO HIT suffered.
Treble Maker.sa2: When HIT while above 50% HEALTH, reflect 15/25/35% of the incoming damage.

Trigger Happy.name: Trigger Happy
Trigger Happy.sa1: 50/75/100% of the damage dealt by STANDARD SHOTS is also suffered by the opponent's teammates.
Trigger Happy.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds each time the opponent's teammates take damage.

Triple Threat.name: Triple Threat
Triple Threat.sa1: Gain IMMUNITY, UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE for 9/12/15 seconds when activating STAR POWER. The BUFF is removed when exiting STAR POWER.
Triple Threat.sa2: 33% chance when using a SPECIAL MOVE to reset all BUFF timers and gain 20/25/30% STAR POWER meter.

True Self.name: True Self
True Self.sa1: Fukua's successful KICK attacks grant a stack of SHADOW KICK (max. 10). Regain 1/1.5/2% MAX HEALTH when gaining a SHADOW KICK stack. The next BLOCKBUSTER used after reaching 10 SHADOW KICK stacks will summon GRENDEL'S HAND to HIT the opponent.
True Self.sa2: When GRENDEL's HAND successfully HITS, gain UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds. When gaining a SHADOW KICK stack while benefiting from UNFLINCHING, deal 2/2.5/3% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent and gain 2/3/4% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Très Chic.name: Très Chic
Très Chic.sa1: While on her own side of the stage, Valentine gains 1 stack of BARRIER, THORNS or ARMOR every 5/4/3 seconds. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Très Chic.sa2: While on the opponent's side of the stage, CRITICAL HITS inflict BLEED, DEATH MARK, or ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

Twisted Mettle.name: Twisted Mettle
Twisted Mettle.sa1: When suffering a CRITICAL HIT, inflict BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds.
Twisted Mettle.sa2: 25/35/50% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3 seconds if opponent is suffering BLEED.

Tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
Tyrannical.sa1: CRITICAL HITS have a 35% chance to inflict BLEED or grant MIASMA for 6 seconds each.
Tyrannical.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of MIASMA, or the opponent suffers from at least 3 stacks of BLEED, CRITICAL HITS have a 50% chance to remove 1 opponent BUFF.

Ultraviolent.name: Ultraviolent
Ultraviolent.sa1: Projectile HITS have a 25/35/50% chance to grant DEADEYE and BARRIER for 15 seconds each.
Ultraviolent.sa2: Projectiles HITS inflict 25/35/50% bonus damage and grant HASTE for 10 seconds while benefiting from DEADEYE.

Unbearable.name: Unbearable
Unbearable.sa1: While Big Band has living teammates, the active Fighter gains a 35% chance when suffering a DEBUFF to convert it to BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds and heal all teammates for 5% MAX HEALTH.
Unbearable.sa2: With one teammate alive, Big Band takes 20% reduced damage and gains a 1% chance to instantly defeat the opponent with TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER HITS. With no teammates alive, these effects are doubled.

Underdog.name: Underdog
Underdog.sa1: Gain ARMOR and HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF.
Underdog.sa2: When Beowulf gains a BUFF, he also gains 5/7/10% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Understudy.name: Understudy
Understudy.sa1: All teammates deal 15/30/50% increased throw damage.
Understudy.sa2: Gain ARMOR for 10/12/15 seconds when THROWING the opponent.

Undying Warrior.name: Undying Warrior
Undying Warrior.sa1: Opponent BLOCKBUSTERS deal 40/80/120/160/200% bonus damage to Marie.
Undying Warrior.sa2: When either Fighter lands a BLOCKBUSTER HIT, inflict DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 10 seconds and grant ENRAGE for 10 seconds.

Unfazed.name: Unfazed
Unfazed.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING and 1/2/3 stack(s) of THORNS for 10 seconds each when either Fighter BOUNCES off a wall.
Unfazed.sa2: Gain MIASMA for 10 seconds every 4/3/2 seconds while benefiting from THORNS.

Unholy Host.name: Unholy Host
Unholy Host.sa1: When Black Dahlia or her opponent TAGS IN, she removes all enemy BUFFS and inflicts CURSE for 10/15/20 seconds.
Unholy Host.sa2: DRAIN 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second from the opponent if they are suffering from CURSE.

Untouchable.name: Untouchable
Untouchable.sa1: 15% chance when either Fighter is hit to gain UNFLINCHING for 4/5/6 seconds and INVINCIBLE for 2 seconds.
Untouchable.sa2: While benefiting from UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE, deal 25/35/50% bonus damage and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.

Vaporwave Vixen.name: Vaporwave Vixen
Vaporwave Vixen.sa1: After IDLING or WALKING for 3/2/1 seconds(s) without suffering a hit, gain UNFLINCHING.
Vaporwave Vixen.sa2: After Fukua and her opponent have not suffered a HIT (including blocked hits) for 2 seconds, gain THORNS and MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds.

Vector Protector.name: Vector Protector
Vector Protector.sa1: Gain ARMOR for 8/10/12 seconds and refresh the timer of all ARMORS when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Vector Protector.sa2: Using a BLOCKBUSTER converts all ARMOR stacks into MIASMA for 8/10/12 seconds.

Vintage Virtuoso.name: Vintage Virtuoso
Vintage Virtuoso.sa1: Gain 1 stack of PRECISION every 15/10/5 combo hits.
Vintage Virtuoso.sa2: PRECISION HITS grant ENRAGE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

Wave Warrior.name: Wave Warrior
Wave Warrior.sa1: Every 15th COMBO HIT, transfer up to 2 opponent BUFFS to self and reduce opponent BLOCKBUSTER METER by 15/20/25%.
Wave Warrior.sa2: While Annie has living teammates, gaining a BUFF permanently increases DAMAGE by 5/7/10% and heals all teammates for 5% HEALTH.

Web Crawler.name: Web Crawler
Web Crawler.sa1: After Painwheel has been in the air for 1 second, gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10/11/12 seconds each.
Web Crawler.sa2: 10/12/15% chance on HIT to remove 1 opponent BUFF and gain EVASION for 10 seconds while near an opponent suffering from GUARD BREAK.

Weekend Warrior.name: Weekend Warrior
Weekend Warrior.sa1: Achieve max HYPE and gain HASTE for 10 seconds when Beowulf first drops below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Weekend Warrior.sa2: When activating HYPE MODE, remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, and HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.

Wetwork.name: Wetwork
Wetwork.sa1: Gain EVASION every 2/1.5/1 second(s) while charging a CHARGE ATTACK.
Wetwork.sa2: When knocking an opponent into the air, Valentine gains ENRAGE and the opponent suffers ARMOR BREAK and DEATH MARK for 4/5/7 seconds.

Wild Child.name: Wild Child
Wild Child.sa1: While not OVERSTUFFED, Umbrella's THROW HITS have a 20% chance to DRAIN 10/12/15% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Wild Child.sa2: Inflict 2 stacks of SLIME for 10/12/15 seconds when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.

Wildcard.name: Wildcard
Wildcard.sa1: Inflict a random DEBUFF for 4/6/8 seconds when using a SPECIAL MOVE. Also once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, regain 10% MAX HEALTH per DEBUFF on the opponent.
Wildcard.sa2: When Peacock suffers a HIT that would be fatal while the opponent is suffering a DEBUFF, reduce their HEALTH by 25/35/50%.

Wind Stalker.name: Wind Stalker
Wind Stalker.sa1: DRAIN 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while the opponent is near Ms. Fortune's head.
Wind Stalker.sa2: Inflict QUIETUS, DEATH MARK, DISABLE TAG INS, and DOOM for 15 seconds each when an opponent's HEALTH drops below 25/30/35%. DOOM is removed if the opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

Windswept.name: Windswept
Windswept.sa1: Your 1st COMBO HIT against an attacking opponent grants ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds and EVASION.
Windswept.sa2: After EVADING, 50/75/100% chance to gain PERMANENT PRECISION. PRECISION is removed when either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN.

Wrestler X.name: Wrestler X
Wrestler X.sa1: Beowulf starts the match with 1/2/3 stacks of permanent REGEN.
Wrestler X.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, all HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict BLEED for 10 seconds.

Wulfsbane.name: Wulfsbane
Wulfsbane.sa1: THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE and HEAL BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds.
Wulfsbane.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against enemies suffering from a DEBUFF.

Wunderkind.name: Wunderkind
Wunderkind.sa1: 50% chance on BLOCKBUSTER HIT to inflict POWER SURGE and gain BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).
Wunderkind.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, the active fighter DRAINS 3/4/5% of the opponent's HEALTH every 3 seconds while they are suffering from 3 or more stacks of POWER SURGE.

X-Bot.name: X-Bot
X-Bot.sa1: Gain PRECISION and inflict DEATH MARK after 3/2/1 second(s) while far away from the opponent.
X-Bot.sa2: Also gain BARRIER and heal for 3/4/5% HEALTH.

Xenomorph.name: Xenomorph
Xenomorph.sa1: 50/75/100% chance when TRANSMUTING to the DARK element to inflict a permanent DOOM effect, killing the enemy after 30 seconds. DOOM will be removed if Double is defeated.
Xenomorph.sa2: When defeated, inflict 1/2/3 stack(s) of permanent BLEED.

Yellow One.name: Yellow One
Yellow One.sa1: Gain BLESSING every 5 seconds. This BLESSING always lasts for 1/1.5/2 second(s) and becomes permanent when using SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS. Permanent BLESSINGS are removed when this BLESSING expires.
Yellow One.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of permanent BLESSING, SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS are UNBLOCKABLE and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.
